tests.name: json_view_pointer_token_leading_zero
tests.intent: Verify that setting a value with a json pointer containing a token with a leading zero like '01' creates an object member rather than throwing parse_error or treating it as an array index.

tests.name: json_view_pointer_token_empty
tests.intent: Verify that setting a value with an empty json pointer token creates an object member rather than throwing.

tests.name: json_view_pointer_valid_array_index
tests.intent: Verify that setting a value with a valid numeric array index token like '1' correctly creates an array and pads with nulls.

tests.name: json_view_pointer_single_zero_index
tests.intent: Verify that a single zero token '0' is correctly treated as an array index.

tests.name: json_view_pointer_dash_token
tests.intent: Verify that a hyphen token '-' is correctly treated as appending to an array.

tests.name: json_view_document_parse_basic
tests.intent: Verify basic parsing and dumping capabilities of basic_json_document.

tests.name: json_view_editable_document_construct
tests.intent: Verify creation and modification of an editable json document.

tests.name: json_view_nested_object_creation
tests.intent: Verify nested object creation via json pointer on an editable document.

tests.name: json_view_mixed_indices_and_objects
tests.intent: Verify mixing array indices and object keys in a json pointer modification.

tests.name: json_view_float_document_overflow
tests.intent: Verify number overflow handling in custom floating point json documents.

tests.name: json_view_editable_float_values
tests.intent: Verify handling of non-finite float types in editable json documents.

tests.name: json_view_push_back_operation
tests.intent: Verify push_back operations on editable document roots.

tests.name: json_view_at_pointer_access
tests.intent: Verify using at() with json pointer on a json_view.

tests.name: json_view_get_type_extraction
tests.intent: Verify type extraction using get() from view nodes.

tests.name: json_view_ordered_editable_document
tests.intent: Verify usage of ordered_json_editable_document preserves key insertion order.

tests.name: json_view_contains_check
tests.intent: Verify contains() method on json_view objects.

tests.name: json_view_size_and_empty
tests.intent: Verify size() and empty() queries on view containers.

tests.name: json_view_iteration_over_object
tests.intent: Verify iteration over keys and values in a json_view object.

tests.name: json_view_type_query_methods
tests.intent: Verify type checking methods like is_object(), is_array(), is_string() on view nodes.

tests.name: json_view_assignment_operator
tests.intent: Verify assignment of values via set method overwrite on existing keys.

tests.name: gen_21
tests.intent: Verify that setting a property with a token starting with 0 followed by letters (e.g. '0a') correctly creates an object member rather than an array.

tests.name: gen_22
tests.intent: Verify that setting a property with a token having multiple digits and a leading zero (e.g. '012') on a null parent creates an object member.

tests.name: gen_23
tests.intent: Verify that setting a value using a multi-character token where the first digit is '0' and others are digits (like '00') evaluates digits flag as false and creates an object.

tests.name: gen_24
tests.intent: Verify that setting a nested pointer containing a token with leading zero like '/a/05/b' correctly treats the middle token as an object member instead of throwing array out of range or parse errors.

tests.name: gen_25
tests.intent: Verify that setting via a json pointer whose token contains non-digit characters mixed with leading zeros checks all_of and fallback to object member creation.
